understanding.goal_understanding: Navigate each level’s grid to step onto and complete all goal cells. A goal cell only completes when the carried piece’s shape, color, and rotation exactly match that goal’s required attributes at the moment you step onto it. Completing all goals advances to the next level; completing all levels wins.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Each move (N/S/E/W) costs 1 stamina. If stamina reaches 0, you lose 1 life and stamina resets to its maximum; losing all lives ends the game (GAME_OVER). Walls block movement; the state provides a list of blocked_directions that must never be chosen because they waste a turn and stamina with no movement. Some tiles modify the carried piece when stepped on: shape modifiers cycle shape 0–5 (wrapping), color modifiers cycle colors in order orange→blue→green→red→orange, and rotation modifiers rotate 90° clockwise (0°→90°→180°→270°→0°). To satisfy a goal, you must route through the needed modifier tiles to adjust attributes, then move onto the goal cell while matched. Efficient routing matters due to limited stamina/turn budget.
